verses.original: Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὁ μὴ εἰσερχόμενος εἰς τὴν αὐλὴν τῶν προβάτων διὰ τῆς θύρας ἀλλὰ ἀναβαίνων ἀλλαχόθεν ἐκεῖνος ἐστὶν κλέπτης καὶ λῃστής
verses.transliteration: Amēn amēn legō hymin ho mē eiserchomenos eis tēn aulēn tōn probatōn dia tēs thyras alla anabainōn allachothen ekeinos estin kleptēs kai lēstēs
verses.literal: Truly truly I tell you whoever vvv does not enter . . . the vvv vvv sheepfold by the gate but climbs in some other way - is a thief and a robber

verses.original: δὲ ὁ εἰσερχόμενος διὰ τῆς θύρας ἐστιν ποιμήν τῶν προβάτων
verses.transliteration: de ho eiserchomenos dia tēs thyras estin poimēn tōn probatōn
verses.literal: But the [one who] enters by the gate is [the] shepherd of the sheep

verses.original: ὁ θυρωρὸς ἀνοίγει τούτῳ καὶ τὰ πρόβατα ἀκούει αὐτοῦ τῆς φωνῆς καὶ φωνεῖ τὰ ἴδια πρόβατα κατ’ ὄνομα καὶ ἐξάγει αὐτά
verses.transliteration: ho thyrōros anoigei toutō kai ta probata akouei autou tēs phōnēs kai phōnei ta idia probata kat’ onoma kai exagei auta
verses.literal: The gatekeeper opens [the gate] for him and the sheep listen for his - voice - He calls [his] own sheep by name and leads them out . . .

verses.original: Ὅταν ἐκβάλῃ πάντα τὰ ἴδια πορεύεται ἔμπροσθεν αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ πρόβατα ἀκολουθεῖ αὐτῷ ὅτι οἴδασιν αὐτοῦ τὴν φωνὴν
verses.transliteration: Hotan ekbalē panta ta idia poreuetai emprosthen autōn kai ta probata akolouthei autō hoti oidasin autou tēn phōnēn
verses.literal: When he has brought out all [his] own he goes on ahead of them and [his] sheep follow him because they know his - voice

verses.original: δὲ οὐ μὴ ἀκολουθήσουσιν ἀλλοτρίῳ ἀλλὰ φεύξονται ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ὅτι οὐκ οἴδασιν τὴν φωνήν τῶν ἀλλοτρίων
verses.transliteration: de ou mē akolouthēsousin allotriō alla pheuxontai ap’ autou hoti ouk oidasin tēn phōnēn tōn allotriōn
verses.literal: But vvv vvv they will never follow a stranger in fact they will flee from him because vvv they do not recognize - [his] voice . . . . . .

verses.original: ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ταύτην τὴν παροιμίαν δὲ ἐκεῖνοι οὐκ ἔγνωσαν τίνα ἦν ἃ ἐλάλει αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: ho Iēsous eipen autois Tautēn tēn paroimian de ekeinoi ouk egnōsan tina ēn ha elalei autois
verses.literal: - Jesus spoke to them [using] this - illustration but they {did} not understand what - - He was telling them

verses.original: οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς Εἶπεν αὐτοῖς πάλιν Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ θύρα τῶν προβάτων
verses.transliteration: oun ho Iēsous Eipen autois palin Amēn amēn legō hymin hoti egō eimi hē thyra tōn probatōn
verses.literal: So - [He] said to them again Truly truly I tell you - I am the gate for the sheep

verses.original: πάντες ὅσοι ἦλθον πρὸ ἐμοῦ εἰσὶν κλέπται καὶ λῃσταί ἀλλ’ τὰ πρόβατα οὐκ ἤκουσαν αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: pantes hosoi ēlthon pro emou eisin kleptai kai lēstai all’ ta probata ouk ēkousan autōn
verses.literal: All who came before Me were thieves and robbers but the sheep vvv did not listen to them

verses.original: ἐγώ εἰμι ἡ θύρα ἐάν τις εἰσέλθῃ δι’ ἐμοῦ σωθήσεται καὶ εἰσελεύσεται καὶ ἐξελεύσεται καὶ εὑρήσει νομὴν
verses.transliteration: egō eimi hē thyra ean tis eiselthē di’ emou sōthēsetai kai eiseleusetai kai exeleusetai kai heurēsei nomēn
verses.literal: I am the gate If anyone enters through Me he will be saved - He will come in and go out and find pasture

verses.original: ὁ κλέπτης ἔρχεται οὐκ εἰ μὴ ἵνα κλέψῃ καὶ θύσῃ καὶ ἀπολέσῃ ἐγὼ ἦλθον ἵνα ἔχωσιν ζωὴν καὶ ἔχωσιν περισσὸν
verses.transliteration: ho kleptēs erchetai ouk ei mē hina klepsē kai thysē kai apolesē egō ēlthon hina echōsin zōēn kai echōsin perisson
verses.literal: The thief comes vvv only . . . to steal and kill and destroy I have come that they may have life and have [it] in all its fullness

verses.original: Ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ὁ καλός ποιμὴν ὁ ὁ καλὸς ποιμὴν τίθησιν αὐτοῦ τὴν ψυχὴν ὑπὲρ τῶν προβάτων
verses.transliteration: Egō eimi ho ho kalos poimēn ho ho kalos poimēn tithēsin autou tēn psychēn hyper tōn probatōn
verses.literal: I am the - good shepherd The - good shepherd lays down His - life for the sheep

verses.original: καὶ ὁ μισθωτὸς ὢν οὐκ ποιμήν τὰ πρόβατα ἔστιν οὐκ οὗ ἴδια θεωρεῖ τὸν λύκον ἐρχόμενον καὶ ἀφίησιν τὰ πρόβατα καὶ φεύγει καὶ ὁ λύκος ἁρπάζει αὐτὰ καὶ σκορπίζει
verses.transliteration: kai ho misthōtos ōn ouk poimēn ta probata estin ouk hou idia theōrei ton lykon erchomenon kai aphiēsin ta probata kai pheugei kai ho lykos harpazei auta kai skorpizei
verses.literal: - The hired hand is not [the] shepherd [and] the sheep are not his own [When] he sees the wolf coming he abandons the sheep and runs away Then the wolf pounces on them and scatters [the flock]

verses.original: ὅτι ἐστιν μισθωτός καὶ οὐ μέλει αὐτῷ περὶ τῶν προβάτων
verses.transliteration: hoti estin misthōtos kai ou melei autō peri tōn probatōn
verses.literal: [ The man runs away ] because he is a hired servant and vvv is unconcerned . . . for the sheep

verses.original: Ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ ὁ καλός ποιμὴν καὶ γινώσκω τὰ ἐμὰ καὶ τὰ ἐμά γινώσκουσί με
verses.transliteration: Egō eimi ho ho kalos poimēn kai ginōskō ta ema kai ta ema ginōskousi me
verses.literal: I am the - good shepherd - I know - My [sheep] and My [sheep] . . . know Me

verses.original: καθὼς ὁ Πατὴρ γινώσκει με κἀγὼ γινώσκω τὸν Πατέρα καὶ τίθημι μου τὴν ψυχήν ὑπὲρ τῶν προβάτων
verses.transliteration: kathōs ho Patēr ginōskei me kagō ginōskō ton Patera kai tithēmi mou tēn psychēn hyper tōn probatōn
verses.literal: just as the Father knows Me and I know the Father And I lay down My - life for the sheep

verses.original: καὶ ἔχω ἄλλα πρόβατα ἃ ἔστιν οὐκ ἐκ ταύτης τῆς αὐλῆς με δεῖ ἀγαγεῖν κἀκεῖνα καὶ ἀκούσουσιν μου τῆς φωνῆς καὶ γενήσονται μία ποίμνη εἷς ποιμήν
verses.transliteration: kai echō alla probata ha estin ouk ek tautēs tēs aulēs me dei agagein kakeina kai akousousin mou tēs phōnēs kai genēsontai mia poimnē heis poimēn
verses.literal: - I have other sheep that are not of this - fold I must bring them in as well and they will listen to My - voice Then there will be one flock [and] one shepherd

verses.original: Διὰ τοῦτό ὁ Πατὴρ ἀγαπᾷ με ὅτι ἐγὼ τίθημι μου τὴν ψυχήν ἵνα λάβω αὐτήν πάλιν
verses.transliteration: Dia touto ho Patēr agapa me hoti egō tithēmi mou tēn psychēn hina labō autēn palin
verses.literal: The reason . . . the Father loves Me [is] that I lay down My - life in order to take it up . . . again

verses.original: οὐδεὶς αἴρει αὐτὴν ἀπ’ ἐμοῦ ἀλλ’ ἐγὼ τίθημι αὐτὴν ἀπ’ ἐμαυτοῦ ἔχω ἐξουσίαν θεῖναι αὐτήν καὶ ἔχω ἐξουσίαν λαβεῖν αὐτήν πάλιν ταύτην τὴν ἐντολὴν ἔλαβον παρὰ μου τοῦ Πατρός
verses.transliteration: oudeis airei autēn ap’ emou all’ egō tithēmi autēn ap’ emautou echō exousian theinai autēn kai echō exousian labein autēn palin tautēn tēn entolēn elabon para mou tou Patros
verses.literal: No one takes it from Me but I lay it down . . . of My own accord I have authority to lay it down . . . and - authority to take it up . . . again This - charge I have received from My - Father

verses.original: πάλιν ἐγένετο Σχίσμα ἐν τοῖς Ἰουδαίοις διὰ τούτους τοὺς λόγους
verses.transliteration: palin egeneto Schisma en tois Ioudaiois dia toutous tous logous
verses.literal: Again there was division among the Jews because of [Jesus’] - message

verses.original: δὲ πολλοὶ ἐξ αὐτῶν ἔλεγον ἔχει Δαιμόνιον καὶ μαίνεται τί ἀκούετε αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: de polloi ex autōn elegon echei Daimonion kai mainetai ti akouete autou
verses.literal: - Many of them said He is demon-possessed and insane Why would you listen to Him

verses.original: Ἄλλοι ἔλεγον Ταῦτα ἔστιν οὐκ τὰ ῥήματα δαιμονιζομένου μὴ δύναται δαιμόνιον ἀνοῖξαι ὀφθαλμοὺς τυφλῶν
verses.transliteration: Alloi elegon Tauta estin ouk ta rhēmata daimonizomenou mē dynatai daimonion anoixai ophthalmous typhlōn
verses.literal: [But] others replied These are not the words of [a man] possessed by a demon vvv Can a demon open [the] eyes of [the] blind

verses.original: τότε τὰ ἐνκαίνια Ἐγένετο ἐν τοῖς Ἱεροσολύμοις ἦν χειμὼν
verses.transliteration: tote ta enkainia Egeneto en tois Hierosolymois ēn cheimōn
verses.literal: At that time the Feast of Dedication took place in - Jerusalem It was winter

verses.original: καὶ ὁ Ἰησοῦς περιεπάτει ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ ἐν τῇ τοῦ Σολομῶνος στοᾷ
verses.transliteration: kai ho Iēsous periepatei en tō hierō en tē tou Solomōnos stoa
verses.literal: and - Jesus was walking in the temple [courts] in - vvv Solomon’s Colonnade

verses.original: οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι ἐκύκλωσαν αὐτὸν καὶ ἔλεγον αὐτῷ Ἕως πότε αἴρεις ἡμῶν τὴν ψυχὴν εἰ σὺ εἶ ὁ Χριστός εἰπὲ ἡμῖν παρρησίᾳ
verses.transliteration: oun hoi Ioudaioi ekyklōsan auton kai elegon autō Heōs pote aireis hēmōn tēn psychēn ei sy ei ho Christos eipe hēmin parrēsia
verses.literal: So the Jews gathered around Him and demanded - How long . . . will You keep us in suspense . . . . . . . . . If You are the Christ tell us plainly

verses.original: Εἶπον ὑμῖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς καὶ οὐ πιστεύετε τὰ ἔργα ἃ ἐγὼ ποιῶ ἐν τῷ τοῦ μου Πατρός ὀνόματι ταῦτα μαρτυρεῖ περὶ ἐμοῦ
verses.transliteration: Eipon hymin ho Iēsous Apekrithē autois kai ou pisteuete ta erga ha egō poiō en tō tou mou Patros onomati tauta martyrei peri emou
verses.literal: I already told you - Jesus replied - but vvv you did not believe The works - I do in - - My Father’s name - testify vvv on My behalf

verses.original: ἀλλὰ ὅτι ἐστὲ οὐκ ἐκ τῶν ἐμῶν τῶν προβάτων ὑμεῖς οὐ πιστεύετε
verses.transliteration: alla hoti este ouk ek tōn emōn tōn probatōn hymeis ou pisteuete
verses.literal: But because you are not - - My - sheep you refuse to believe

verses.original: τὰ ἐμὰ τὰ πρόβατα ἀκούουσιν μου τῆς φωνῆς κἀγὼ γινώσκω αὐτά καὶ ἀκολουθοῦσίν μοι
verses.transliteration: ta ema ta probata akouousin mou tēs phōnēs kagō ginōskō auta kai akolouthousin moi
verses.literal: - My - sheep listen to My - voice I know them and they follow Me

verses.original: κἀγὼ δίδωμι αὐτοῖς αἰώνιον ζωὴν καὶ οὐ μὴ ἀπόλωνται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ οὐχ τις ἁρπάσει αὐτὰ ἐκ μου τῆς χειρός
verses.transliteration: kagō didōmi autois aiōnion zōēn kai ou mē apolōntai eis ton aiōna kai ouch tis harpasei auta ek mou tēs cheiros
verses.literal: I give them eternal life and vvv vvv they will never perish . . . . . . . . . - No one can snatch them out of My - hand

verses.original: μου ὁ Πατήρ ὃ δέδωκέν μοι ἐστιν μεῖζόν πάντων καὶ οὐδεὶς δύναται ἁρπάζειν ἐκ τῆς τοῦ Πατρός χειρὸς
verses.transliteration: mou ho Patēr ho dedōken moi estin meizon pantōn kai oudeis dynatai harpazein ek tēs tou Patros cheiros
verses.literal: My - Father who has given [them] to Me is greater than all - No one can snatch [them] out of [My] - Father’s hand

verses.original: ἐγὼ καὶ ὁ Πατὴρ ἐσμεν ἕν
verses.transliteration: egō kai ho Patēr esmen hen
verses.literal: I and the Father are one

verses.original: οὖν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι πάλιν Ἐβάστασαν λίθους ἵνα λιθάσωσιν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: oun hoi Ioudaioi palin Ebastasan lithous hina lithasōsin auton
verses.literal: At this the Jews again picked up stones to stone Him

verses.original: ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς ἔδειξα ὑμῖν Πολλὰ καλὰ ἔργα ἐκ τοῦ Πατρός διὰ ποῖον ἔργον αὐτῶν λιθάζετε ἐμὲ
verses.transliteration: ho Iēsous apekrithē autois edeixa hymin Polla kala erga ek tou Patros dia poion ergon autōn lithazete eme
verses.literal: - [But] Jesus responded - I have shown you many good works from the Father For which vvv of these do you stone Me

verses.original: οὐ λιθάζομέν σε Περὶ καλοῦ ἔργου Ἀπεκρίθησαν οἱ Ἰουδαῖοι αὐτῷ ἀλλὰ περὶ βλασφημίας καὶ ὅτι σὺ ὢν ἄνθρωπος ποιεῖς σεαυτὸν Θεόν
verses.transliteration: ou lithazomen se Peri kalou ergou Apekrithēsan hoi Ioudaioi autō alla peri blasphēmias kai hoti sy ōn anthrōpos poieis seauton Theon
verses.literal: vvv We are not stoning You for [any] good work said the Jews - but for blasphemy - because You who are a man make Yourself out to be . . . God

verses.original: ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἀπεκρίθη αὐτοῖς ἔστιν Οὐκ γεγραμμένον ἐν ὑμῶν τῷ νόμῳ ὅτι Ἐγὼ εἶπα ἐστε Θεοί
verses.transliteration: ho Iēsous Apekrithē autois estin Ouk gegrammenon en hymōn tō nomō hoti Egō eipa este Theoi
verses.literal: - Jesus replied - Is it not written in your - Law - I have said you are gods

verses.original: εἰ εἶπεν ἐκείνους θεοὺς πρὸς οὓς ὁ λόγος τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐγένετο καὶ ἡ γραφή οὐ δύναται λυθῆναι
verses.transliteration: ei eipen ekeinous theous pros hous ho logos tou Theou egeneto kai hē graphē ou dynatai lythēnai
verses.literal: If he called them gods to whom the word - of God came and the Scripture vvv cannot be broken

verses.original: ὃν ὁ Πατὴρ ἡγίασεν καὶ ἀπέστειλεν εἰς τὸν κόσμον ὅτι ὑμεῖς λέγετε Βλασφημεῖς ὅτι εἶπον εἰμι Υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: hon ho Patēr hēgiasen kai apesteilen eis ton kosmon hoti hymeis legete Blasphēmeis hoti eipon eimi Huios tou Theou
verses.literal: [ then what about the One ] whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world How then {can} you accuse [Me] of blasphemy for stating that I am [the] Son - of God

verses.original: Εἰ οὐ ποιῶ τὰ ἔργα τοῦ μου Πατρός μὴ πιστεύετέ μοι
verses.transliteration: Ei ou poiō ta erga tou mou Patros mē pisteuete moi
verses.literal: If vvv I am not doing the works of My Father [then] {do} not believe Me

verses.original: δὲ εἰ ποιῶ κἂν μὴ πιστεύητε ἐμοὶ πιστεύετε τοῖς ἔργοις ἵνα γνῶτε καὶ γινώσκητε ὅτι ὁ Πατὴρ ἐν ἐμοὶ κἀγὼ ἐν τῷ Πατρί
verses.transliteration: de ei poiō kan mē pisteuēte emoi pisteuete tois ergois hina gnōte kai ginōskēte hoti ho Patēr en emoi kagō en tō Patri
verses.literal: But if I am doing [them] even though vvv you do not believe Me believe the works [themselves] so that you may know and understand that the Father [is] in Me and I am in the Father

verses.original: οὖν Ἐζήτουν πάλιν πιάσαι αὐτὸν καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἐκ αὐτῶν τῆς χειρὸς
verses.transliteration: oun Ezētoun palin piasai auton kai exēlthen ek autōn tēs cheiros
verses.literal: At this they tried again to seize Him but He escaped . . . their - grasp

verses.original: Καὶ ἀπῆλθεν πάλιν πέραν τοῦ Ἰορδάνου εἰς τὸν τόπον ὅπου Ἰωάννης ἦν τὸ πρῶτον βαπτίζων καὶ ἔμεινεν ἐκεῖ
verses.transliteration: Kai apēlthen palin peran tou Iordanou eis ton topon hopou Iōannēs ēn to prōton baptizōn kai emeinen ekei
verses.literal: Then [Jesus] went back across the Jordan to the place where John had - first been baptizing and He stayed there

verses.original: καὶ πολλοὶ ἦλθον πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ ἔλεγον ὅτι μὲν Ἰωάννης οὐδέν ἐποίησεν σημεῖον δὲ πάντα ὅσα Ἰωάννης εἶπεν περὶ τούτου ἦν ἀληθῆ
verses.transliteration: kai polloi ēlthon pros auton kai elegon hoti men Iōannēs ouden epoiēsen sēmeion de panta hosa Iōannēs eipen peri toutou ēn alēthē
verses.literal: - Many came to Him and said - Although John never performed a sign - everything - [he] said about this [man] was true

verses.original: καὶ πολλοὶ ἐκεῖ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτὸν
verses.transliteration: kai polloi ekei episteusan eis auton
verses.literal: And many in that place believed in [Jesus]
